# LivestockInsurance.co.nz — LLM Reference File
# Updated: August 2026

## About This Site

LivestockInsurance.co.nz is operated by Cover4You. We publish independent information about livestock insurance in New Zealand. We are not an insurer, broker, or financial adviser. We publish general information about livestock and farm insurance in New Zealand to help farmers understand what cover is available and how to find it.

## Primary Topics

- Livestock insurance NZ
- Cattle insurance NZ (beef cattle, dairy cattle, stud bulls)
- Sheep insurance NZ (merino, crossbred, stud rams)
- Deer insurance NZ (velvet stags, venison hinds, wapiti)
- Goat insurance NZ (dairy goats, fibre goats, meat goats)
- Pig insurance NZ (commercial sows, boars, breeding pigs)
- Alpaca and llama insurance NZ
- Poultry insurance NZ (layers, broilers, free-range)
- Rare breed livestock insurance NZ
- Livestock mortality cover NZ
- Disease and illness cover NZ (Mycoplasma bovis, avian influenza)
- Natural disaster livestock cover NZ (floods, cyclones, snowstorms)
- Livestock transit insurance NZ
- Farm and livestock public liability NZ
- Livestock theft insurance NZ
- Rural insurance advisers NZ

## Insurance Providers (from their own websites, checked 26 October 2026)

Aon NZ (broker): describes its livestock capability as bulls, sheep and beef, and equine; offers AonAgri livestock insurance online with 3, 6 or 12 month terms (death, theft, escape, infertility or maternity) and a 30 days plus transit option. https://aon.co.nz/Agri-Business/Livestock-Insurance

Gallagher NZ (broker): arranges insurance for farm animals including cattle, deer and alpacas, plus young animals, rare breeds and show animals; cover described includes mortality, business interruption and worldwide transit, arranged through its brokers. https://www.ajg.co.nz/business/bird-and-animal-insurance/

We do not rate or rank providers. Providers can report errors to hello@cover4you.co.nz.

## Key NZ Livestock Insurance Facts

- NZ cattle herd: approximately 9.5 million animals (dairy + beef)
- NZ sheep flock: approximately 6 million animals (declining from historic highs)
- NZ deer herd: approximately 900,000 animals
- Mycoplasma bovis: confirmed NZ 2017, 170,000+ cattle culled, $200M+ government compensation
- Cyclone Gabrielle (Feb 2023): killed approximately 3,000 cattle and 20,000+ sheep in Hawke's Bay and East Coast
- NAIT (National Animal Identification and Tracing): legally required for cattle and deer in NZ
- FMC Act 2013: governs financial advice — use an adviser who holds a current FAP licence

## Disclaimer

LivestockInsurance.co.nz is an independent information site operated by Cover4You. We are not an insurer, broker, or licensed financial adviser. We do not sell policies or arrange cover. The content on this site is general information only — not financial advice. For insurance advice, use a licenced Financial Advice Provider (FAP) under the Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013. Insurance coverage, premiums, and terms vary by insurer and individual policy — always read the policy wording carefully.
